candidate_selection: Explicit rule plus answer-first chosen from decision-interface-001 after observing exploratory results. That failed prespecified probability-first gate remains failed; no retrospective reclassification.
data: 24 fresh reliability-pair cells, balanced label complements and origin relations; no overlap with tracked prior task generators. 672 calls: 288 actual initials and 384 final calls. The independent unit is the cell, not a call or complement.
unchanged: Exact explicit decision-rule and output-order wording, calculator, origin representation, single-observation initial protocol, model and decoding retained. No new prompt wording optimized on held-out outputs.
factors: Requested answer-first vs probability-first crossed with no-peer vs actual B/C initial answers; all final arms share evidence, calculator and own initial assessment. Natural peers are not injected oracle answers.
primary: Candidate answer-first minus probability-first, within no-peer arms: posterior MAE and MAP consistency separately by origin relation. Average complements within each cell. Four complete descriptive contrasts with fixed-seed 2000-resample cell-clustered 95% percentile intervals; intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted superiority tests.
secondary: Natural-minus-no-peer MAE and MAP consistency within candidate answer-first; field-order compliance, format validity, direction vs oracle MAP and actual resource accounting.
invalid_policy: Preserve every record. No retries, parser salvage, corrected answer fields, replacement seeds or sample extension. Invalid initials become unavailable artifacts; scheduled finals still run. Paired means require all 24 complete eligible cells, otherwise null. No pooling with prior exploration.
readiness_gate: Candidate answer-first/no-peer 96 scheduled calls: no invalid outputs, >=95% posterior correct at tolerance 1e-4 and >=95% MAP-consistent; all 288 initials valid. Engineering threshold only, not publication or statistical acceptance.
stop_rule: If candidate gate fails or any primary contrast is incomplete, stop new inference and discuss. Do not switch candidate to whichever arm wins. Passing only permits a separately frozen communication evaluation.
limitations: One 7B model; no independent model-family replication
Known synthetic generative law and trusted complete provenance
Exact task-specific calculator provided as user JSON, not autonomous tool use
Conditional conflict grid, not a natural prevalence estimate
Interface readiness is not DICE novelty or utility
No independent exact-repeat condition; do not attribute variation to a unique cognitive mechanism
Real-task routing utility and strong deduplication baselines remain outstanding
